posts.author: MuteDay
posts.body: var oldGP_gainItem_Tiny_PUI = Game_Party.prototype.gainItem;    Game_Party.prototype.gainItem = function (item, amount, includeEquip) {        if(_usedParams['auto_pop']==='On') {            if(amount>=0) {                var container=this.itemContainer(item);                if(container) {                    $gamePlayer.requestPopUp(item,amount);                }            }        }        if(Imported.YEP_ItemCore) {            if(DataManager.isIndependent(item)) {                this.gainIndependentItem(item,amount,includeEquip);            } else {                Yanfly.Item.Game_Party_gainItem.call(this,item,amount,includeEquip);            }        }        else {            oldGP_gainItem_Tiny_PUI.call(this,item,amount,includeEquip);        }    };hope that helps, it is so yanfly itemcore and this can get along, may need tested but should work

posts.author: Lantiz
posts.body:
TheHarmp said:
I really like this plugin! Thank you so much!
Is it possible to keep the auto popup on for positive stuff (gaining items) but off for negative stuff (losing items, using items)
Or a way to have the negative stuff show with a red text for example?
Click to expand...
Open the script file and look for this part:
if (_usedParams['auto_pop'] === 'On') {
then change to:
if (_usedParams['auto_pop'] === 'On' && amount > 0) {
It's going to disable popups for negative numbers
